caseNameFull: Albemarle Paper Co. v. Moody and Halifax Local No. 425, United Papermakers & Paperworkers, AFL-CIO v. Moody

opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 419 U. S. 1068.] Motion of American Society for Personnel Administration for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted.

Mr. Justice Marshall and Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the.consideration or decision of this motion.*
